dataset.citation: Fanaee-T, H., & Gama, J. (2013). Event labeling combining ensemble detectors and background knowledge. Progress in Artificial Intelligence, 2(2-3), 113-127. DOI: 10.24432/C5W894

random_forest.notes: Best performer. Ensemble handles non-linear demand patterns well.

xgboost.notes: Strong gradient boosting. Nearly tied with Random Forest.

seasonal_naive.notes: Baseline. Predicts same hour from 7 days ago. Useful sanity check.

sarima.notes: Poor fit. Likely model misspecification or convergence issues with hourly data. Not recommended for this dataset.

validation: Time-series split: train 2011-2012 through Nov 2012, test final 30 days (Dec 2012). No data leakage.
honesty_note: SARIMA performed poorly on this dataset. We report it honestly rather than hiding it. Random Forest and XGBoost are the recommended models.
